verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents its own APIs for the core objects: sending alerts, creating and updating cases, listing and fetching cases, batch case import, and validating, filing and monitoring filings. Many UI features have no documented API equivalent, including attachments, file rename, approvers, comments, CSV/report exports and workflow configuration. The API reference itself is password-gated with no public spec, so UI parity cannot be verified. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for attachments, comments, approvals, exports, settings and workflow configuration; a public API reference or OpenAPI spec; any explicit API/UI parity claim; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
